name: ZX_TAXES_B_
description: This table stores taxes and the related attributes for multiple configuration owners. Each row stores a tax for a specific regime and configuration owner.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax code

columns.name: TAX_EXCPT_CREATE_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether, for this tax, the user will define exceptions specific to this tax or use the exceptions specified for another tax if an exception specific to this tax is not found.

columns.name: TAX_EXCPT_SOURCE_TAX
columns.description: Indicates the source tax from which the application picks up the exception if a specific exception is not found for this tax.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for this tax

columns.name: TAX_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to idnicate the classification of this tax

columns.name: ALLOW_MANUAL_ENTRY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the user is allowed to manually enter tax lines for this tax

columns.name: ALLOW_TAX_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the user is allowed to override tax calculated by the system for this tax

columns.name: MIN_TXBL_BSIS_THRSHLD
columns.description: Minimum taxable basis threshold amount

columns.name: MAX_TXBL_BSIS_THRSHLD
columns.description: Maximum taxable basis threshold amount

columns.name: MIN_TAX_RATE_THRSHLD
columns.description: Minimum tax rate threshold

columns.name: MAX_TAX_RATE_THRSHLD
columns.description: Maximum tax rate threshold

columns.name: MIN_TAX_AMT_THRSHLD
columns.description: Minimum tax amount threshold

columns.name: MAX_TAX_AMT_THRSHLD
columns.description: Maximum tax amount threshold

columns.name: COMPOUNDING_PRECEDENCE
columns.description: Column to store the sequence in which this tax is detemined when taxes are compounded

columns.name: PERIOD_SET_NAME
columns.description: Accounting calendar name

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type for transaction currency to tax currency conversion

columns.name: TAX_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Tax currency code

columns.name: TAX_PRECISION
columns.description: Tax currency precision

columns.name: MINIMUM_ACCOUNTABLE_UNIT
columns.description: Tax currency minimum accountable unit

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Rounding rule code to be used for rounding this tax. Possible values are UP, DOWN and NEAREST.

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this tax to determine tax status

columns.name: TAX_RATE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this tax to determine tax rate

columns.name: DEF_PLACE_OF_SUPPLY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Default place of supply type for this tax

columns.name: PLACE_OF_SUPPLY_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this tax to determine place of supply type

columns.name: DIRECT_RATE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether direct tax rate determination rate rules can be defined for a given tax

columns.name: APPLICABILITY_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined to determine applicability of this tax

columns.name: TAX_CALC_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this tax to calculate tax amount

columns.name: TXBL_BSIS_THRSHLD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether taxable basis threshold is applicable for this tax

columns.name: TAX_RATE_THRSHLD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax rate threshold is applicable for this tax

columns.name: TAX_AMT_THRSHLD_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether tax amount threshold is applicable for this tax

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this tax to determine taxable basis

columns.name: DEF_INCLUSIVE_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this tax is tax inclusive by default

columns.name: THRSHLD_GROUPING_LVL_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate grouping level for applying thresholds across or within documents or lines or calendar periods

columns.name: HAS_OTHER_JURISDICTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this tax has more than one jurisdiction

columns.name: ALLOW_EXEMPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether exemptions are allowed for this tax

columns.name: ALLOW_EXCEPTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether exceptions are allowed for this tax

columns.name: ALLOW_RECOVERABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this tax is recoverable

columns.name: DEF_TAX_CALC_FORMULA
columns.description: Default formula code used to determine tax amount for this tax

columns.name: TAX_INCLUSIVE_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the user can override the inclusiveness/exclusiveness nature of a tax line determined by the application for this tax. Only if this flag is set to Y, this control can further be overridden at the rate level.

columns.name: DEF_TAXABLE_BASIS_FORMULA
columns.description: Default formula code used to determine taxable basis amount for this tax

columns.name: DEF_REGISTR_PARTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate default registration party type for this tax

columns.name: REGISTRATION_TYPE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this tax to determine registration party type.

columns.name: REPORTING_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this a reporting only tax

columns.name: AUTO_PRVN_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: LIVE_FOR_PROCESSING_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this tax is ready to be processed during tax calculation. Before this flag can be set to Y, the application validates that the basic configuration like default status, etc. for this tax is complete.

columns.name: HAS_DETAIL_TB_THRSHLD_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: HAS_TAX_DET_DATE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: HAS_EXCH_RATE_DATE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: HAS_TAX_POINT_DATE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: PRINT_ON_INVOICE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this tax will be displayed on the printed document

columns.name: USE_LEGAL_MSG_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether legal messages are applicable for this tax

columns.name: CALC_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates that this tax is used only by calculation, and is neither reported nor returned to the product

columns.name: PRIMARY_RECOVERY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Primary recovery type code that is applicable for this tax

columns.name: PRIMARY_REC_TYPE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this tax to determine primary recovery type code

columns.name: SECONDARY_RECOVERY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Secondary recovery type code that is applicable for this tax when more than one recovery types is needed

columns.name: SECONDARY_REC_TYPE_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this tax to determine secondary recovery type code

columns.name: PRIMARY_REC_RATE_DET_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this tax to determine primary recovery rate

columns.name: SEC_REC_RATE_DET_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether rules are defined for this tax to determine secondary recovery rate

columns.name: OFFSET_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if this tax is used to offset another tax

columns.name: RECOVERY_RATE_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if the tax recovery rate can  be overridden for this tax

columns.name: ZONE_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Primary geography type for which jurisdicitons of this tax are created. This referes to either a master or a tax geography type.

columns.name: REGN_NUM_SAME_AS_LE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the registration number of the tax registration for this tax should be same as the legal entity registration number

columns.name: DEF_REC_SETTLEMENT_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether an input tax can be recovered when an invoice is recorded or only when the invoice is paid and whether an output tax is due for settlement when the invoice is issued or only when the payment is received against it.

columns.name: PARENT_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Column to store the georgaphy type of the georaphical area that confines all tax jurisdictions created for this tax when the primary geography type refers to a master geography type

columns.name: PARENT_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Column to store the Id of the georaphical area that confines all tax jurisdictions created for this tax when the primary geography type refers to a master geography type

columns.name: ALLOW_MASS_CREATE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N to indicate whether tax jurisdictions can be automatically created for this tax based on the primary geography type and optionally, the parent geography Id/Type

columns.name: APPLIED_AMT_HANDLING_FLAG
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate how the tax amount of a prepayment in Payables is to be handled when it is applied to an invoice

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: ALLOW_ROUNDING_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: This indicates whether the rounding rule can be verridden at Tax Registration level. Needs to be included.

columns.name: SOURCE_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if this tax can be used as a source tax for creating other taxes. If this is a source tax, then it can not be created based on any other tax.

columns.name: DEF_PRIMARY_REC_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Default primary recovery rate code for this tax

columns.name: ALLOW_DUP_REGN_NUM_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether duplicate tax registration numbers are allowed for this tax

columns.name: DEF_SECONDARY_REC_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Default secondary recovery rate code for this tax

columns.name: SPECIAL_INCLUSIVE_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if special inclusive tax handling is applicable for this tax

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: TAX_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for configuration owner of this tax

columns.name: REP_TAX_AUTHORITY_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the tax authority to whom this tax is reported

columns.name: COLL_TAX_AUTHORITY_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the tax authority to whom this tax is remitted

columns.name: THRSHLD_CHK_TMPLT_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor template to be used for sub-grouping of total thresholds

columns.name: TAX_ACCOUNT_SOURCE_TAX
columns.description: Column to record the source tax from which the application picks up the default GL accounts for this tax

columns.name: TAX_ACCOUNT_CREATE_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether for this tax, the user will define GL account defaults specific to this tax, or will make use of the defaults specified for another tax

columns.name: OVERRIDE_GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Column to store the type of georaphical area that can override the tax rate specified for a tax jurisdiction of primary geography type

columns.name: LIVE_FOR_APPLICABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: For internal use to handle location based taxes migrated from prior releases for Receivables

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TAX_EXMPT_CR_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether for this tax, the user will define exemptions specific to this tax, or will also make use of the exemptions specified for another tax if an exemption specific to this tax is not found

columns.name: TAX_EXMPT_SOURCE_TAX
columns.description: Column to record the source tax from which the application picks up the exemption for this tax, if a specific exemption fis not found for this tax

columns.name: APPLICABLE_BY_DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates if this tax is applicable by default or not

columns.name: LEGAL_REPORTING_STATUS_DEF_VAL
columns.description: Legal reporting status

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: TAX_POINT_BASIS
columns.description: Tax Point Basis for this tax

columns.name: SELF_ASSESS_DIFF_TAX
columns.description: Column to store self assessed differential tax.

columns.name: WHT_BUCKET_LEVEL_FLAG
columns.description: Values P (Party) or A (All) indicate the withholding accumulations level for transactions.

columns.name: PROCESS_WHT_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No indicates withholding calculation on indirect tax.

columns.name: WHT_CALC_POINT_FLAG
columns.description: Point of withholding application. Possible values are P (payment) and I (invoice).

columns.name: VALIDATION_TYPE
columns.description: Reporting type defined for registration Number validation.

columns.name: VALIDATION_LEVEL
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether validation is based on an error or a warning.

columns.name: UNIQUENESS_VALIDATION_LEVEL
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether validation is for all parties or a specific party.

columns.name: TAX_AUTH_INV_CREATION_POINT
columns.description: Point at which a withholding tax authority invoice is created.  Possible values are INVOICE for invoice and PAYMENT for payment.

columns.name: TAXABLE_AMT_MAU
columns.description: Minimum accountable unit for rounding the taxable amount.

columns.name: CHARGE_LINE_HANDLING_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate whether tax rules should be processed on charge lines, or tax lines should be copied from corresponding item lines.

columns.name: THRSHLD_SCHEDULE_GRP_LVL_FLAG
columns.description: Threshold schedule group level indicator. Possible values are L for line, D for document, P for period, and S for set.

columns.name: WHT_DATE_BASIS
columns.description: To indicate whether the withholding date basis to be adopted for the tax is invoice date or accounting date.

columns.name: ALLOW_ZERO_AMT_WHT_INV_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether zero amount withholding invoices and accounting can be created. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: INVOICE_AMOUNT_WHT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether withholding tax is calculated on the invoice amount or on partial payment amount when an invoice is paid partially.

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT_WHT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if threshold and schedules are applied on a group of installments in a payment or on individual installments.

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_EXEMPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether taxable basis exemption rates are defined for this tax.

columns.name: THRSHLD_PRODUCT_CATEGORY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether withholding thresholds and schedules are defined by product category or product fiscal classification for this tax.

columns.name: DEF_RECOVERY_SPL_HANDLING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the accounting to move the tax recoverable amount from the interim account to the final recoverable account is to be deferred till the point when additional events (such as proof of payment of customs duty) have occurred. (The standard handling for deferred recovery will move the amount from interim to recoverable based on the amount paid for the invoice.) Valid values are Y for "Yes" and "N" for "No".

columns.name: DEFAULT_TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Default tax status code for this tax.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Default tax rate code for this tax.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
